reason: 该仓库的 dsh-cinematography 被定位为电影运镜与镜头语言参考的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，README 明确给出了面向用户的三类工具接口（列出运镜、查询运镜、列出镜头类型），因此主要用于知识教学/说明型检索辅助，而非代码生成、终端操作或外部服务编排。

summaries.zh: dsh-cinematography 是一个电影运镜与镜头语言参考插件，提供运镜列表、单项运镜查询和镜头类型列表等查询工具。
summaries.en: dsh-cinematography is a DSH plugin for cinematography references, offering tools to list camera movements, fetch movement details, and list shot types.

capabilities: Offers plugin tools for listing camera movements, retrieving a movement entry, and listing shot types.
Provides film language reference data for interactive use in DeepSeek Harness.
Uses only peer dependencies for host-provided runtime integration, not bundling runtime third-party modules.
